materials.name: HA50 Type 1
materials.peel_condition: 1 oz before thermal stress (1.75 N/mm after)
materials.notes: Type 1 of the HA50 aluminium base laminate (1.0 W/m K class); sold as KL HA50. Thermal conductivity by ASTM E1461. Surface and volume resistivity are 10^6 Mohm and 10^7 Mohm cm (C96/35/90; the E-24/125 values are 10^5 and 10^5). Thermal stress: 180 s at 288 C without delamination, 6 cycles of 300 C for 10 s. AC breakdown 4.3 kV (100 um), 5.0 kV (125 um) and 6.0 kV (150 um) where listed. Thermal resistance by type: 0.77 K m2/W. The sheet gives no thicknesses, copper or panel sizes.
